ValidationRule.description: If user and account in different territory, or account record type not equals to 'HeadQuarter', and current profile is not 'CG Cloud Mobile - TSM', Visit can not be created.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND($Profile.Name ='CG Cloud Mobile - TSM',AND( Account.RecordType.Name = 'Headquarter', Account.TPB_Account_Territory__c <> $User.TPB_Territory__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please create visits to headquarter accounts within your territory
